resources.string: Auto Clicker service used to simulate repetitive clicking operations at specified locations. Once enabled, you can control the start and stop of clicks through the floating ball.
Used to simulate click gestures, must be enabled
Used to display the control floating ball
Drag to position, tap to start/stop
Please enable Accessibility Service and Floating Window permissions first
Screen recording permission is required for screenshot recognition

1. Enable \"Accessibility Service\" permission: Open the accessibility service switch on the home page, go to system settings, find AutoClicker and enable it\n2. Enable \"Floating Window Permission\": Open the floating window permission switch on the home page, go to system settings, and allow this app to display over other apps

Purpose: Automatically and repeatedly click at specified locations on the screen

1. Click "Clicker" at the bottom to enter the clicker page
2. Set "Click Interval": The waiting time between two clicks in milliseconds (e.g., 100ms = 10 clicks per second)
3. Set "Click Count": 0 means infinite clicks until manually stopped
4. Click the "Start Clicking" button
5. A floating ball will appear on the screen; drag it to the target position that needs to be clicked
6. Tap the floating ball to start auto-clicking
7. Tap the floating ball again to stop clicking
8. You can drag the floating ball to adjust its position at any time during clicking

Purpose: Fast and automatic clicking at specified coordinate positions, suitable for flash sales or rush-buying scenarios

1. Click "Rush Buy" at the bottom to enter the rush buy page
2. Set "Target X Coordinate": The horizontal coordinate (in pixels) of the position to click
3. Set "Target Y Coordinate": The vertical coordinate (in pixels) of the position to click
4. Target coordinates can be obtained via screenshots or developer tools
5. Set "Click Interval": Recommended to be set to 50-100 milliseconds
6. Set "Click Count": Recommended to be set to 0 (infinite clicks), stopped manually
7. Set "Duration": Time to automatically stop in seconds, 0 means no automatic stop
8. Click "Start Rush Buy", and the engine will continuously and rapidly click at the target coordinates
9. You can view the running status in real-time on the rush buy page; click "Stop Rush Buy" to end

Purpose: Automatically operate the Damai app via accessibility nodes to automatically select seats and submit orders

1. Click "Grab Tickets" at the bottom to enter the ticket grabbing configuration page
2. In the "Session" area: Enter keywords for the show session you want to grab (e.g., "Saturday", "Evening Show"), click add, and you can add multiple alternatives
3. In the "Price" area: Enter keywords for acceptable ticket price tiers (e.g., "580", "880"), click add, and you can add multiple alternatives
4. In the "Spectator" area: Enter the spectator's name and click add; multiple spectators can be added
5. Expand "Advanced Settings" to adjust:
 - Operation interval (ms): Waiting time between each step, recommended 200-500
 - Max retry attempts: Number of re-tries after tickets are sold out, recommended 50-100
6. Open the Damai app and go to the target show's details page (stay on the show details page)
7. Return to this app and click the "Start Grabbing Tickets" button
8. The engine will automatically execute the following process:
 ① Automatically click "Select Session" and match preset sessions
 ② Automatically click "Select Price" and match preset prices
 ③ Automatically check the spectator
 ④ Automatically click "Submit Order
9. A floating log window will be displayed during the process, showing the status of each step in real-time
10. It will automatically stop when tickets are successfully grabbed, and will auto-retry when sold out
11. You can click "Stop Grabbing Tickets" at any time to terminate manually

• Please ensure that the Damai app is logged in and information such as shipping address and spectators are completely filled out before grabbing tickets\n• Ticket grabbing speed is affected by the network environment and server response. This tool only assists operation and does not guarantee absolute success\n• Please set the operation interval reasonably; going too fast may result in system restrictions

AutoClicker Auto Clicker

Version: 1.0.0

A versatile automation tool supporting features such as auto-clicking, rush-buying, and ticket-grabbing.

Achieves automated operations through accessibility services, making repetitive tasks simpler and more efficient.
